mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_id, user_name, user_password, user_email, user_phone, user_gender, user_birth, user_address, user_status, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{userPassword}, #{userEmail}, #{userPhone}, #{userGender}, #{userBirth}, #{userAddress}, #{userStatus}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_num as user_num, u.user_id as user_id, u.user_name, u.user_password, u.enabled, u.refresh_token, r.id as role_id, r.name as role_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_num = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId};
